real_work.description: The capability intake guard detects the CommonJS export forms the tokenizer-based detection missed: logical assignment on a named export (exports.a ??= 1, ||=), bracket access (module['exports'], exports['a']) and an alias of module or exports taken from the bare identifier. Strings, comments, template literals, aliases of unrelated objects and other property names stay undetected. The production change in tools/cli/lib/capability-intake-guard.js (+98 lines, one block next to detectExports) was written by the model through one governed patch with `within` on a large file; two executor adjustments followed (see formatting and adjustments).
real_work.prompt_nature: PRESCRIPTIVE: the prompt lists the three gaps and the controls, gives the absolute-numbered excerpts, the patch window and the fact that the tokenizer collapses strings to "", from which the solution (decide bracket names from the original content) follows. It proves the governed route, NOT the model's design ability.

adjustments.adjustment_1_lint: lint-adjustment.diff: eslint refused the model output (2x unicorn/prefer-string-replace-all, 1x no-useless-escape; a fourth, replaceAll(/\$/g) -> replaceAll('$'), appeared after the first fix). Four equivalent swaps, no rule loosened. The AST is NOT identical (replace vs replaceAll). Equivalence argument: replaceAll with a global regex equals replace with /g; the escape inside a character class does not change the set; replaceAll('$', fn) equals the global regex of one literal char. Checked by a discardable differential: detectExports before and after on 1290 sources (repository files, literals of the guard test, the cjs gaps cases) in js and cs gave 0 differences of 2580
adjustments.adjustment_2_dedup: dedup-adjustment.diff: the model's cjsGapExports recomputed inspectedSegments, the dominant cost, so detectExports took about twice as long (1 MB: 88 ms on master, 172 ms patched) and failed the existing 200 ms performance test under load (209 ms). detectExports now computes the inspected text once and passes it to detectExportsBase and cjsGapExports (12 changed lines, no new branch). Measured under equal conditions (load about 14): 1 MB without module/exports 68 ms master, 65 ms after; with module.exports 62 vs 68; 64 ambiguous slashes plus cjs 89 vs 90, against 123/123/184 before the adjustment. Differential after vs before = 0 of 2580. Both adjustments are executor changes on top of the model output.
